name: Kewaunee RV & Campground
note: Family-run park on the north edge of Kewaunee, about half a mile from downtown and the city marina: grass sites on gravel roads, with a seasonal section (sites 1-25 and 32; the site's text adds 69-72) beside the nightly sites, plus 7 tent sites and 4 rustic cabins. Opening day for the 2027 season is April 30. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site kewauneerv.com read 2026-11-17: Rates & Rules page (Squarespace updatedOn 2026-07-02) posts daily rates for Water/Electric 20/30A $50, Full hookup $56 (+tax, 2 adults + 3 children), online booking (ResNexus link) or phone 920-388-4851, no application/lease; Grounds Map: 74 numbered RV sites (seasonal 1-24 + 32 per map legend, 1-25, 32, 69-72 per page text -> 44+ of 74 sold by the night, over 50%, no long-stay caveat), pull-through W/E sites, 7 tent sites, 4 cabins; homepage 'Large easy-access pull-through sites available in addition to large rig accommodations'; Esri imagery shows 25-35-ft trailers on the loop. Price gate: cheapest RV site $50 = at, not over, US$50 -> pass (gateways.py: none within 40 km). Presence: own website with rates + phone + booking link; Google Maps 4.5/224 with phone, open (gm.py 2026-11-17); RV Life 4.5*/$$$ (avg_rate 42). Not a Good Sam Park. No horse/OHV. Not a duplicate: the only DB entry within 5 km is 13421 Kewaunee Marina Campground (city lot 1.1 km S on the harbor).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-17: Esri World Imagery (1.8 km frame and 440 m frame centred 44.4757,-87.5047, both rendered): the loop sits in fields west of WI-42 on Kewaunee's north edge; the Kewaunee River and its marsh lie ~300 m west behind continuous woodland and a row of houses, no sightline from any pad; Lake Michigan's shore is ~1 km east across WI-42, a second road and a residential/commercial strip, so coastal walk is ruled out (highway and town between). No site near water -> not waterfront. The operator's 'Lake Michigan' / '1 mile from the marina' copy is marketing distance, not frontage.

flags: Price gate at the line: cheapest RV site (water/electric) is exactly US$50 before tax; full hookup is $56. Kept as 'not over $50'; Google 4.5/224 is strong if a tiebreaker is wanted.
Minimum stay unknown: the ResNexus booking engine was not opened (lead rules); the operator pages state no minimum (holiday-weekend bookings are only non-refundable).
Season group omitted: the site gives opening day 2027 (Fri April 30) but no closing date.
Seasonal count differs on the operator's own pages: map legend says 1-24 + 32 seasonal, map page text says 1-25, 32 and 69-72; either way 44+ of 74 RV sites are nightly.
Homepage says '50 full-hookup sites', but the map lists 20 nightly full-hookup sites (the seasonal rows are presumably full hookup too).
Pin moved ~35 m W of the Google pin (office) to the centre of the site loop.
curation_note: WI phase-7 lead 3 (found p3-512 beside 13421 Kewaunee Marina; vetted 2026-11-17). Long-stay tests: posted nightly rate + online booking (2), no published minimum (3), 44+ of 74 nightly (4), RV park (5). Price exactly $50 = pass.
